recommendations.speaker: Hans Isoz
recommendations.reasoning: Bad investment where guest didn't do sufficient due diligence. Missed management compensation details and acquisition structure.
recommendations.quote: Sämsta, jag skulle vilja säga det är en tuff konkurrens här. Nej men sämsta är... Man går ju inte på vatten här. Det som jag tycker är absolut sämst som jag har gjort är nog Katena Media.

summary: Interview with investor Hans Isoz about his concentrated investment strategy focusing on 3-4 main positions. Discusses his long-term holding in Enlabs and rejection of undervalued buyout bid, bullish view on Angler Gaming's growth and dividends, speculative bet on Intervax horse vaccine approval, and short-term play on Evolution Q4. Emphasizes importance of concentration and deep knowledge of investments.
key_takeaways: Concentrated portfolio strategy (3-4 positions with >1% ownership each)
Enlabs buyout bid of 40 SEK rejected by 10.7% of shareholders as undervalued
Angler Gaming offers high growth (50-75%) with 5-10% dividend yield
Intervax awaiting EMA approval for horse vaccine with >90% probability
Importance of doing thorough due diligence and understanding management
